parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a man phoning a recruitment agency to inquire about employing new staff. First, you have some time to look at questions one to four.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to four.

Hello, Morgan Recruitment Agency. How may I help you?

Hello. I need to employ some new staff for my company, and I believe your agency can help with that.

Yes, of course. First, I'll get some details from you. Can I have your name, please?

Sure. My name is Peter Smith.

And can I also get a contact number?

Our number here is zero four seven triple eight three nine two five.

Thank you. Can I also take down some details about your company? What's your company name?

It's Vander Transport.

Is that V-A-N, that's N for November, D-E-R?

That's right. We are a large trucking company.

The transport industry is really booming, especially for fresh fruit and vegetables, isn't it?

Yes. We have a fleet of refrigerated trucks, though, so we mostly carry frozen goods, fish, vegetables, pizza, all sorts.

I see. So you said that you need some new staff members. When would you need them to start?

We'd like them to start around the twenty-seventh of August.

Just looking at my calendar here, the twenty-seventh is a Sunday, so do you mean the twenty-eighth?

[laughs] Yes, that's right. We're hoping to hold any interviews around July twenty-ninth.

I'll get more details of that later.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions five to ten on page two.

Now listen and answer questions five to ten.

Okay. Now, could you tell me about the jobs you have available, so we can hopefully find some suitable candidates?

Sure. The first position is an office manager.

So does the job involve typical management duties?

Yes, but they also have to liaise with our main client, which is a large supermarket chain. So a background in a company like that is essential.

Okay, I'll note that down. It sounds like an important role. What are the minimum qualifications? Do they need a university education, like a degree?

Yes. Candidates would definitely have one.

Okay. Can you tell me about the next position?

We're looking for a full-time mechanic.

So I assume the job will involve doing general repairs on trucks.

Yes, that's right. And one of the other key responsibilities is to produce a written report for each vehicle.

I think we have several people on our books that would be suitable. And will the mechanic be doing much traveling?

Some, yes, but not a great deal. Unlike our next vacancy, that's for a full-time truck driver.

Right. What kind of shifts are they expected to work?

They usually travel around one thousand kilometers over a five-day period.

I see.

This job is different to our usual ones, though. It involves moving animals.

That sounds interesting.

Yes. Our company has just got a new contract, so we've bought new trucks and want a driver with that kind of experience.

Great. Is there anything else I should make a note of?

Well, we own all of the trucks, but apart from their driving duties, it is up to all our drivers to clean their vehicle between trips. We do give them extra time for that.

Okay. And are there any other positions available?

Yes. We're looking for a warehouse supervisor.

And what will this involve?

They'll be in charge of our new warehouse. It's located close to the airport. We've recently moved out of the city center.

Oh, that must be more convenient. And what are some of the requirements for this role?

The successful candidate would be able to work effectively in a busy environment. Sometimes they'll be on call twenty-four hours for our nighttime deliveries.

So given the hours they'll be working, I assume it will be necessary for the candidate to have a car.

Yes, that's right. Buses and trains just don't operate at those times, unfortunately.

Okay, Mr. Smith. I'll have a look at the job seekers we have on our books and see if we have any suitable candidates for the positions you have available.

That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

analyses.content: 录音中直接报出了电话号码“zero four seven triple eight three nine two five”，直接写下来即可。
And can I also get a contact number? Our number here is zero four seven triple eight three nine two five.
你可能会漏听或写错位数，注意录音中的“triple eight”表示连续三个8。
What's your company name? It's Vander Transport. Is that V-A-N, that's N for November, D-E-R? That's right.
你可能会把N听成M，但录音特意补充强调了是“N for November”。
男士报出公司名字是Vander Transport后，女士进行了逐字母拼写确认“V-A-N-D-E-R”，写下拼写即可。

The transport industry is really booming, especially for fresh fruit and vegetables, isn't it? Yes. We have a fleet of refrigerated trucks, though, so we mostly carry frozen goods, fish, vegetables, pizza, all sorts.
你可能会听到前面的“fresh”就直接填了，但这只是女士的猜测干扰项，不是该公司的实际主要货物。
男士纠正了女士关于“新鲜果蔬”的猜测，明确指出他们主要用冷藏车运送“frozen goods”（冷冻食品），对应卷面上的food。

When would you need them to start? We'd like them to start around the twenty-seventh of August. Just looking at my calendar here, the twenty-seventh is a Sunday. So do you mean the twenty-eighth? [chuckles] Yes, that's right.
你可能会直接写下最先听到的27号，遇到时间日期题一定要继续往后听完两人确认纠正的过程。
男士一开始说8月27日，但女士提醒那是周日并反问是不是28日（the twenty-eighth），男士最后确认了是28日。
What are the minimum qualifications? Do they need a university education like a degree? Yes. Candidates would definitely have one.
你可能会想填university education，但题目字数限制是“一个单词”，所以填同义替换的精确名词degree。
女士提问最低资格是不是需要像“degree”（学位）这样的大学教育背景，男士给予了肯定的答复。
男士提到除了维修卡车，另一项关键职责是为每辆车出具一份书面的“report”（报告）。
So I assume the job will involve doing general repairs on trucks. Yes, that's right. And one of the other key responsibilities is to produce a written report for each vehicle.
你可能会把修饰词“written”当成答案填进去，注意题目缺的是动作承受的物品名词（报告）。

This job is different to our usual ones, though. It involves moving animals. That sounds interesting. Yes. Our company has just got a new contract, so we've bought new trucks and want a driver with that kind of experience.
你可能会忽略名词的复数形式，录音中明确发出了animals的复数尾音，且卷面上them也提示了复数。
男士说明这个工作与平常不同，主要内容是运输“animals”（动物），并且需要有这方面经验的司机。

Is there anything else I should make a note of? Well, we own all of the trucks, but apart from their driving duties, it is up to all our drivers to clean their vehicle between trips. We do give them extra time for that.
你可能会听到前面的“driving duties”就分心了，要抓住“it is up to all our drivers to...”后面紧跟的实际动作。
男士明确提到，除了驾驶任务外，所有司机还要在两趟行程之间“clean”（清洁）他们的车辆。
They'll be in charge of our new warehouse. It's located close to the airport. We've recently moved out of the city center.
你可能会听到后面的“city center”（市中心），但这紧跟在“moved out of”（搬离）后面，属于过去的位置干扰项。
录音中明确提到新仓库的地理位置在“airport”（机场）附近（close to the airport）。
So given the hours they'll be working, I assume it will be necessary for the candidate to have a car. Yes, that's right. Buses and trains just don't operate at those times, unfortunately.
你可能会听到“buses and trains”，但这属于时间不合适被明确排除的交通工具，不要填入。
女士推测由于工作时间特殊，候选人必须自己有一辆“car”（车），男士给出了肯定的答复。
